bounded_store.why: fetchCache memoises the promise per url including the null it resolves to on a failed fetch, and LruCache at the pin exposes no delete at all, so a poisoned entry structurally cannot be forgotten.
bounded_store.confirmed_by: stakeout substrate evidence ('A fetch rejection ... is caught, logged with console.error, and resolves as null'; 'The LruCache applies its bounded eviction behavior at capacity 100') + manhunt on LruCache (class, 30 lines, packages/utils/src/lib/LruCache.ts)

false_positive_ranked_higher.verbatim: ensureFontIsLoaded(font) { const existingState = this.getFontState(font); if (existingState) return existingState.loadingPromise; ... .catch(err => { ... this.fontStates.update(font, s => ({...s, state: 'error'})) })
false_positive_ranked_higher.why: A genuine second instance of the same symptom - a per-font-face promise kept forever, marked state:'error' but never discarded, so a failed font load can never be retried. Verified verbatim and ranked 2. It is not gold; the golden's 'per-object promise' is the per-shape export promise in ImageShapeUtil/VideoShapeUtil (PR #10226), which this run also returned at ranks 13 and 14.

stale_resolution.why: Only reacts when the resolved url differs from the previous url, so a removed or re-pointed asset keeps rendering the stale result.
stale_resolution.confirmed_by: stakeout substrate evidence ('When the resolution is active and the URL differs from the previous URL, the asset and URL are stored')

dropped_reference.why: An asset id that cannot be resolved is skipped when gathering content for the next consumer rather than carried across unresolved; deleteAssets calls this.store.props.assets.remove?.(ids) with the removal error swallowed.
dropped_reference.confirmed_by: the_receipts search on the pinned commit

what_worked: Repo-scoped first search. One stakeout with knowledgeId+commitHash pinned to tldraw put fetchCache.ts, useImageOrVideoAsset.ts, Editor.ts, bookmarks.ts, ImageShapeUtil.tsx and VideoShapeUtil.tsx on the page in a single call. The previous case's lesson - never sweep org-wide on a 15-repo case - paid for itself immediately.

One collateral_damage on fetchCache.ts returned FontEmbedder.ts, embedMedia.ts and StyleEmbedder.ts as direct importers, and the contracts lens reached parseCss.ts. Three of those four are gold, and parseCss.ts is a file the bare probe could not reach by grep.

manhunt name='LruCache' resolved the phrase 'the store has no operation for forgetting an entry at all' to packages/utils/src/lib/LruCache.ts in one call - a 30-line generic utility in a different package from the defect, with no shared vocabulary.
the_receipts with contextLines=0 on the 11,762-line Editor.ts returned 190 matching lines for 32x less than the full file and located both halves of the fourth defect.

Both contract-owner citations were read straight off the prompt: 'paused, resumed, cancelled and asked for its status' is unmistakably query-core's Retryer, and 'enumerates the three outcomes explicitly as distinct states' is jotai's Loadable. Neither needed a search.
what_went_wrong: bookmarks.ts was returned without being folded, so its sibling BookmarkShapeUtil.tsx - same directory, same PR - was never reached. That is the run's only miss, and one collateral_damage call would have closed it.

FontManager.ts was ranked 2 on verbatim evidence of the exact symptom described, but the golden's per-object-promise defect is elsewhere. Confirming a real instance of the contract violation is not the same as confirming the gold instance; the prompt says four places, and finding a fifth real one does not tell you which four the fix touched.

Six export-pipeline files (embedMedia, getSvgJsx, exportToSvg, SvgExportContext, getSvgAsImage, ImageAlphaCache) and four schema/util files were carried as closure filler and are all non-gold. They cost 10 of the 15 false positives.
lessons: Fold every ranked hit that names a defect, not just the anchor. bookmarks.ts was identified as a defect site and still shipped unfolded - the same omission that cost the previous case its second gold file.

A verbatim-confirmed instance of the described symptom is evidence the diagnosis is right, not evidence the file is gold. When the prompt counts the sites ('four different places'), a fifth confirmed site means the ranking, not the diagnosis, needs work.

Repo-scoping the first stakeout is worth more than any later escalation on these cases. Case xrepo-h03 spent four org-wide sweeps and got its rank-1 hit from reasoning instead; this case spent one scoped sweep and got six gold files from it.

retriever.surface: Opus 5 (1M) with the plumbline knowledge-graph MCP server plus Bash, run INTERACTIVELY in a normal Claude Code session. Not the sandboxed headless arm configuration.
retriever.surface_pure_note: Bash was used only to read run_prompt.txt (via Read), golden.json in PHASE 2, the arm folder listing, and the cost helper - never to search or read a pinned checkout. All 27 returned paths came from plumbline tools.
retriever.isolation: NONE. No sandbox-exec profile; golden.json was readable throughout and was read in PHASE 2 as the prompt instructs. PHASE 1's array was emitted in full before any gold file was opened, so the ranked answer is gold-blind in sequence but not kernel-enforced.
retriever.shared_session: This session also ran case xrepo-h03 (hard-a-falsy-value-is-still-a-value) before this one. Context from that case - including its golden.json, read in its PHASE 2 - was in the window during this run. No file, repo or contract overlaps between the two golds (h03: query/tldraw/redux-toolkit on presence-vs-truthiness; h02: tldraw/query/jotai on cached failed resolution), and the only shared path is tldraw packages/utils/src/lib/control.ts, which is gold in h03 and is NOT in this answer. Treat this as a real but bounded contamination risk.
retriever.checkout_verified_note: run_prompt.txt instructs 'Do not verify checkouts, do not check revisions, do not run any gates.' Every plumbline call against tldraw passed commitHash 5590d14d8edd explicitly.
retriever.index_drift_note: No gold file is in a drifted repo. All three gold repos (tldraw, query, jotai) are indexed at exactly the pinned commit.

cost.efficiency_note: 5 plumbline calls and 21,944 result tokens produced 12 of 13 gold files. The single scoped stakeout (~13,177 tok) carried 6 of them; collateral_damage (~7,506 tok) added 3 more; manhunt cost 888 tokens and bought LruCache.ts.
cost.cost_comparability_note: Interactive session, caching on, two cases sharing one context, and the scoring phase billed alongside the retrieval. Not comparable to the sandboxed headless arms on any axis. Re-run under run.sh with DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING=1 for a like-for-like number.

not_comparable_reason: Interactive in-session rerun, not the sandboxed headless arm: no sandbox-exec isolation, Bash available, prompt caching on, and the session had already run case xrepo-h03 including its PHASE 2 gold read. PHASE 1's ranking was produced before this case's golden.json was opened, so the recall/precision numbers are usable as a retrieval signal, but they are not a like-for-like arm result.
